study: Five fresh independent simulated beginner mouse-only RILL composition attempts after latest-main rebase

protocol.study_type: Five fresh independent simulated beginners, not a human user study
protocol.agent_context: Fresh fork_turns=none tasks; no previous feedback, source code or peer sessions provided
protocol.task: Compose a 30-second piece using audio plus MIDI through a VST instrument, save the project and export WAV and MIDI using only a mouse. Give the piece a chosen name if possible. Before exporting, use the Mixer to balance the audio and MIDI track volumes and pan, try mute and solo, and create a bus and send if you can discover how.
protocol.comparison_note: Rounds7and8 use the same five musical personas, task, mixer follow-up, report questions, mouse driver, viewport and lab audio configuration. Earlier rounds did not explicitly ask for mixer exploration, so their ratings are historical context rather than a controlled comparison. Elapsed time includes screenshots, tool overhead and reporting pauses; it is not a human performance or hardware latency benchmark. Each cycle uses a separately frozen validated build.
protocol.inputs: Only screenshots plus logged click, double-click, drag, drag_hold, down, up, scroll and pointer move. No keyboard input, project injection or source inspection during attempt.
protocol.reset: Five new native windows on :781–:785, empty caches and fresh working directories. No projects or preferences from prior participants. Settings seed only 48 kHz / 1024 frames. Unmodified production starter audio and byte-identical native Rill Lab Sine VST3.
protocol.rating_scale: 1–5; higher means more of the named quality. Higher confusion is worse.
protocol.audio: Per-session timer-paced PulseAudio virtual sink via ALSA bridge at48kHz, Rill requested1024 output frames and PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC=60. No physical hardware or listening claims. Shared host, software graphics and virtual backend can affect responsiveness; this is not a latency benchmark.
protocol.validation: Independent read-only verification of saved project ZIP, embedded audio, native VST assignment, MIDI events and WAV samples; isolated analysis copies rendered with frozen binary to check actual audio and VST mix contributions. Original outputs remain unmodified.
protocol.reporting: Observable action/reaction summaries, screenshots and timestamped mouse logs, not private reasoning transcripts.
protocol.frozen_build: Native executable and adjacent plugin helper frozen only after coordinator confirms validation; git HEAD/main, staged+unstaged source diff, untracked source archive, full source hashes and executable hashes recorded.
limitations: No window manager; native dialog placement may differ from desktop installations.
Only the native laboratory sine VST is included; no third-party compatibility claims.
Audible quality is not assessed unless explicitly auditioned and documented.
fixed_questions: Did you complete and save the requested piece?
Did WAV and MIDI export show success?
Which mixer tasks could you discover and complete: volume, pan, mute, solo, bus, and send? Report the visible result or blocker for each attempted task.
What actions were easy or difficult, and what visible evidence supports each observation?
Rate ease, appearance, speed, confusion and feature completeness from1to5, explaining each rating.
What remains unverified, including heard audio and file contents?

build_conditions.comparison_note: Round7 and round8 use the same compiler/profile settings. Earlier rounds used debug-info builds; do not infer platform performance gains from cross-round timing.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both mixer faders. Drum display changed from -6.0 to -7.5 dB; instrument from -2.5 to -7.1 dB. Later playback showed meter activity; no audible balance claim.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged both mixer pan knobs horizontally. Final displayed pan was drum L11 and instrument R13.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked drum Mute, saw it highlighted, then restored it. Repeated during recovered playback and restored before final save.
mixer_outcome.solo: Initial clicks missed after banner-driven layout shifts. A later click visibly highlighted instrument Solo. Restored it, then repeated during recovered playback and restored before final save.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus appeared as a bus strip at 0.0 dB with output to Master. After adding the send it showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Instrument Add send opened routing. + Send > New bus added a 0.25x Post send. The strip showed Send · New bus and a Post send routing line; later bus meter activity was visible.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a small electronic dance groove.

mixer_outcome.volume: Completed visibly: dragged drums fader from -6.0 to -7.5 dB and MIDI fader from -2.5 to -8.6 dB. Final arranger and mixer retained these values. No audible balance judgment.
mixer_outcome.pan: Completed visibly: horizontal drags changed drums to L16 and MIDI to R21; values persisted in final arranger.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked drums Mute; its orange outline appeared. Clicked again to disable it before saving/exporting. Audible effect unverified.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo; its green outline appeared. Clicked again to disable it before saving/exporting. Audible effect unverified.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Mixer Add bus; a New bus channel appeared with 0.0 dB and center pan, feeding Master. It remained in the final arrangement.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing showed New bus at 0.25x with Post selected. The mixer showed the send label and routing line, and the bus label showed 1 in. No send level adjustment or effect was added.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short melodic instrumental.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged audio fader to -8.4 dB and MIDI fader to -4.4 dB, with numeric feedback. Bus remained 0.0 dB. No auditory balance judgment.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged audio pan left to L20 and MIDI pan right to R20; both labels and knobs changed.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute; it visibly highlighted amber. Clicked again to clear. Final Mixer and arrangement show it off.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo; it visibly highlighted, and a later screenshot showed MIDI/master meter activity with audio meter empty. Cleared Solo before save and export.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked top Add bus; New bus appeared as a distinct BUS strip and later showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked audio Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed 0.25x with Post selected. Mixer displayed Send · New bus and a Post send routing line; the bus meter later became active.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL user interested in a short ambient soundtrack sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged Circuit drums from -6.0 to -10.8 dB and New instrument from -2.5 to -4.6 dB; both numerical readouts visibly changed.
mixer_outcome.pan: Diagonal knob drags initially produced audio R7 and MIDI R28. A horizontal left drag then set audio L16; MIDI remained R28. Final arrangement displays those values.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute; button highlighted amber and audio level meter went dark while the MIDI meter remained active after Retry. Later turned it off after dismissing the error banner; final Mute buttons were unhighlighted.
mixer_outcome.solo: After correcting for controls shifting with the error banner, clicked MIDI Solo and observed green highlight. Clicked again to disable; final Solo buttons were unhighlighted. Audible isolation not assessed.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus in Mixer; a New bus strip appeared at 0.0 dB routed to Master.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI track Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a send to New bus at 0.25x with Post selected. No effect inserted and audible send result not assessed.

participants.persona: Simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a short hip-hop beat with a simple synth part.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both faders: Circuit drums changed from -6.0 to -7.5 dB; New instrument changed from -2.5 to -8.4 dB. Values remained visible in final arrangement. No audible balance claim.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged pan knobs; final labels were drums L10 and instrument R21. First drum attempt did not visibly change the value; a later horizontal drag did.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked Circuit drums Mute, observed its orange active highlight, then clicked it again. Final Mixer and arrangement showed it off.
mixer_outcome.solo: Early clicks missed after layout shifts. A corrected click at the visible New instrument Solo button produced a teal active highlight in 22-solo-active.png; clicked again to leave it off.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Mixer Add bus; New bus appeared with 0.0 dB, centered pan and output to Master.
mixer_outcome.send: New instrument Add send > + Send > New bus created a visible 0.25x Post send. Mixer showed Send · New bus, Bus 1 in and Post send -> New bus routing arrow.

comparison_limits: Rounds7and8 add an explicit mixer task absent from earlier rounds; only round7→8 is directly comparable.
Elapsed time includes screenshots and reporting; input events include new held-gesture actions and are not equivalent to physical gesture counts.
Round1 did not explicitly encourage a chosen project name; later rounds did.
Each round evaluates its frozen build; ratings are never retroactively applied to later fixes.
